findings.problem: Identity changes clear the transient key but do not fence the awaiting result. The old result can update the new identity; because redaction compares against the already-cleared transient.apiKey, a callback echo containing the original virtual key is displayed. findings.resolution: Main now uses request generation/currentIdentity plus an independent submitted-secret redaction value.
